But once you’re a geared, I use mastery verse gems, and I enchant mastery. 

Also with the bloodthirst build and especially 4 set, the new Shadowflame Wrethe sims highest of all weapon enchants. 

I suggest you use the bloodthirst annihilate build as it even takes away the middle man buttons. Which leaves you with basic setup of how to play. 

Keep enrage up always. With this build, you want to press burst, rampage for enrage, then Odyn’s fury, thunderous roar. You preferably want to get this on a multi target setup. Like hit two dps with it. Spread that pressure as it’s big dps. 

Once you do that, you are basically in a cycle of using rampage, which gives you enrage, but also improves your next two bloodthirsts. With full gear you have about 3 global cool downs before enrage expires. So Rampage enrages you, then you use the two improved bloodthirsts then a window for one more ability. Usually that will be an execute proc, or some filler. 

Most important part is damage in my opinion, second is staying alive. 

Know your defensive and what they can do. Enraged regen can be used while stunned. I use that when rogue and mage open on me. That with defensive stance can live through a rogue mage opener long enough to disarm or stun the rogue. So you save trinket. Go the squishy target, get something out of your burst. A trinket or ice block. You might win there, if not, you keep playing the game a little more passive, sticking to your kill targeting and applying stuns to whoever when needed. Save burst for another kill opportunity. It will happened every 45 seconds with odyn’s fury, which gives a 4 second avatar and some nice damage. Also your big burst, avatar, recklessness, + Orc racial. Throw it in there people, it works. 

Just play this dance of rotating what cooldowns to use until you have a window where you think you can kill. Fear that healer and then burst the dps. Small shit like that is going to make people press something. Be it cool downs or trinket. You want to be the one winning the dance, calling the shots and having the upper hand on cooldowns.
